title: Zero-Shot Entity Retrieval via Knowledge-Aware Hierarchical Graphs
summary: This community centers on a specific research paper presented at WSDM 2023 that addresses the challenge of zero-shot entity retrieval. The work proposes a method for modeling fine-grained information using a knowledge-aware hierarchical graph structure. It was authored by a collaborative team of six researchers and published in the proceedings of the Sixteenth ACM International Conference on Web Search and Data Mining.
key_findings: The core contribution is a paper titled 'Modeling Fine-grained Information via Knowledge-aware Hierarchical Graph for Zero-shot Entity Retrieval'.
The research was published in the proceedings of WSDM 2023, held in Singapore from February 27 to March 3, 2023.
The paper was authored by six individuals: Siheng Li, Taiqiang Wu, Weigang Guo, Weijie Liu, Xingyu Bai, and Yujiu Yang.
The specific technical approach involves utilizing a knowledge-aware hierarchical graph to model fine-grained information for retrieval tasks.

The work is situated within the broader context of retrieval-augmented generation and knowledge graph applications, as indicated by its proximity to other RAG and KG-related citations in the source text.
